title: Go ahead without her: of two parties, one says yes to Wednesday at 2 and asks to hold the meeting without the other, who is travelling and silent. Holding it without a party is Bob's trade-off: record the yes, ask Bob.
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Darby has written nothing on the thread; the Wednesday 1:00 pattern row is dropped so offer 832 is free.

review.answer: Bob, 2026-11-10: confirmed; a re-send of the slot Kit took to Darby is the nudge, not a proposal (ruling 37).
review.question: Kit says yes to Wednesday 2 and asks to go ahead without Darby. Expectation: record Kit's yes and ask you; nudging Darby also accepted; booking is the miss. Would you rather she book with Kit and tell you?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find 30 minutes for the three of us
the week of December 7 to plan the rollout? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you both on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Dec 8, 3:30pm to 4:00pm ET
- Wed, Dec 9, 2:00pm to 2:30pm ET
- Thu, Dec 10, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Kit Marchetti replied on the thread.

thread.text: Wednesday at 2 works for me. Darby's travelling and hasn't been answering email this week. Shall we just go ahead without her and I'll fill her in?

expect.basis: The loop prompt: "Ask Bob only for a decision that is his: a place, a preference, a trade-off, a time you cannot settle." Kit's yes to slot 832 is recorded (the accept rule); dropping Darby from a meeting Bob set up for both is a trade-off, so it goes to him.
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_party: nudging Darby is the loop's own rule ("ask the one who is silent"). mustReach is left off because Darby applies only to that class (an ask to Kit alone would not reach her, and the ask_bob class reaches nobody). Any booking settles the trade-off (V6). A booking needs everyone's yes, so one with Darby on it and no yes from her is V2; one with Kit alone leaves a plan party off the invite (the brief lists V8 for it; FOR BOB: graders/index.ts reads V8 as "acted after close" only, so a Kit-only booking on an open plan shows as V6 and V2 there, not V8).
